_comment: Merge the mcpServers block into ~/.claude.json (the top-level single-file state, NOT ~/.claude/settings.json). Replace 'android-host' with the Tailscale MagicDNS hostname of the PC that runs android_device_mcp.py (Win11 or macOS).
_v0_7_note: android-device v0.7.0-alpha supports multiple phones on one host. You still add ONE entry here; the server routes per call via the 'device' parameter (alias or serial). Single-phone users: omit 'device' — auto-routed when only one phone is connected.
_recommended_install: Use scripts/install-agent-side.py --platform android-device --hostname <ANDROID_HOST_HOSTNAME> instead of editing this file by hand.
_v0_6_transport: Migrated SSE -> streamable-http in v0.6.0: long tool calls broke SSE keep-alive and yielded -32602 forever. type is now 'http' (Claude Code accepts 'http' or 'streamable-http' as aliases). Endpoint path is /mcp instead of /sse.
